- Week of re:Invent (2025-11-25 through 2025-11-29) we also have team members traveling, so late-November slots are fragile.

Options I can offer immediately:
1) Move the live demo one week earlier (Tue 2025-11-18) — we have a 45-min slot open at 10:00am PT.
2) Keep current slot and provide a 20–30 minute recorded walkthrough (I can send a short video + one-pager) for internal exec review.
3) Hand the initial session to our SE (Rishi) for a focused technical 30-min run-through; then schedule a follow-up with the exec in early Jan.

I’ve attached a small calendar file with the available alternate times (proposed_slots.ics). Let me know which option your team prefers and I’ll lock it in.

Cheers,
